decisions.reason: Retain the combined department because its official remit explicitly includes supply chain; use full official label.

units.name: Department of Management Science & Information Systems
units.evidence: Official department page identifies the full department name and College of Management parent, with supply chain programs at undergraduate, graduate and doctoral levels and faculty research on supply chain strategies.
